name: The Velan Reach - Book One: An Unbroken Line
source: An adult steampunk Visual Novel where you take on the role of a scientist joining a mission of discovery and wonder. Travel to strange new worlds and get to know your traveling companions (quite intimately so in some cases).
translation: 一部成人蒸汽朋克视觉小说，你将扮演一名科学家，参与发现和奇迹的使命。前往陌生的新世界并了解你的旅伴（在某些情况下非常亲密）。
